hooks.quote: Everyone should create a hook for Claude Code that adds an “ultrathink” prompt to requests ending in “-u”.

signature.caption: in every agent's system prompt
signature.why: Our pick: one line he puts in every agent's system prompt, after two weeks of A/B tests, so agents stop acting as if the world stays static.
signature.quote: put “You are AGI-pilled.” in your system prompt for all agents now.

archetype.why: Trusts the model, approves without reading, and runs nine AI tabs at once.
